places.title: Iron Works
places.description: More gastropub than classic tavern, Iron Works serves innovative and updated takes on American classics. Open daily for dining and takeout

places.title: Austin's Texas BBQ
places.description: Within a very short time, you will be able to enjoy the taste of Texas in the only authentic Texas BBQ restaurant in Colombia. We serve lunch and dinner. We offer catering, delivery, outdoor seating, take out and walk-ins are welcome. Ubicado en la vía a Subachoque, entre las montañas de la vereda La Cuesta rodeados de caballerizas y un ambiente campestre, Austin's es el sitio ideal para relajarse y disfrutar del original BBQ Texano y una variedad de acompañamientos auténticos de Texas. Olvídate del caos de Bogota por unas horas con el único - Authentic Texas Style BBQ - de Colombia.

places.title: LeRoy and Lewis Barbecue
places.description:
Join us for a Special Steak Dinner Experience featuring our locally sourced steaks, butchered and aged in house. Steaks will be pre-selected by our team based on party size and current inventory. Steaks are $90 per pound and on average are 2.5-3.5 pounds each. Guests will be offered a tour of our BBQ pit to learn our steak smoking and grilling process. Steaks are cooked to temperature desired and served family style. Our servers can customize guest's experience at the time of arrival with appetizers, select BBQ meats, sides, dinner menu entrees, and desserts for an additional cost based on availability.

Wines by the glass, Special Wine Bottles, Local Beers and low ABV Cocktails can be ordered at the bar or from your server and are priced on the menu accordingly. We do NOT allow BYOB of any kind.

places.title: Lenoir
places.description: Great new restaurant. Lots of buzz from foodies. Locally sourced, creative food.

places.title: EastSide ATX
places.description: Eastside staple recently remolded and a brand new menu. Nothing but good vibes, southern inspired food, and a collection of local Texas favorites. Open for lunch and dinner 7 days a week, and serving up our cure-all boozy brunch every weekend.

places.title: The Driskill Grill
places.description: The Driskill Grill is one of Austin's most iconic restaurants. As a renowned Austin institution, it has been the site of many legendary events including the location of President Johnson and Lady Bird Johnson's first date. The Driskill Grill continues its tradition of excellent service and refined American cuisine, offering guests an authentically Austin and distinctively Driskill dining experience.

places.title: Doc B's Fresh Kitchen
places.description: Set in a comfortable and inviting atmosphere, Doc B's Restaurant & Bar serves food made from scratch daily. Incorporating the highest-quality ingredients, the menu includes a variety of entree-sized salads, & "very special” entrees, crave-worthy burgers and sandwiches, signature Wok Out Bowls™, indulgent desserts and so much more. Doc B’s also impresses with an extensive craft beer, wine and spirits selection in addition to signature cocktails. No matter what occasion, the expansive menu truly offers something for everyone. With each location having its own personality, Doc B’s Austin offers live music daily on our large, vibrant outdoor patio with a retractable canopy, TVs, heaters, misters and fans designed to enjoy during any season. In addition, the expansive bar area is perfect for mingling with friends.

places.title: Black Iron Eats
places.description: Black Iron Eats is on a mission to be the best. We're passionate about taste, committed to quality, and hyper-focused on 'clean and safe' standards. Every meal we make, from catered private events to take-out sandwiches, is designed to nourish your body and your spirit, and make your day a little better (or a lot). We make amazing food, and we make it with integrity.

places.title: Austin Food Works
places.description: The Original Barbecue joint of Stockholm since 2015 bringing you a true food experience. Friendly service, great Barbecue n' Mexican flavors, perfect cocktails, beautiful rustic industrial setting, sunny outdoor serving. Welcome y'all!!!

places.title: Rudy's Barbecue
places.description: Rudy's "Country Store" and Bar-B-Q serves Real Texas Bar-B-Q seven days a week. They offer breakfast, lunch, dinner and group meals.

places.title: Café No Sé
places.description: Located in South Congress Hotel, Café No Sé is a sunny corner café featuring seasonal brunch, lunch, coffee, cocktails, and desserts.

places.title: Federalist Pig
places.description: Fresh barbecue cooked daily emphasizing fresh ingredients, curated sandwiches, specialty sides, and sauces influenced by soul food and different regions in the states, while taking inspiration from great grilling cultures from around the world, using different woods, rubs and cooking techniques. The menu will change based on seasonality and experimentation.

places.title: BRQ Seafood and Barbeque
places.description: Family owned and operated. 4 Years in a row 225 Magazine Best BBQ of Year, DIG Magazine Best BBQ, Bandito Fest Best BBQ, and Top 5 Local Restaurants. "Our philosophy is simple: We believe in providing the best barbeque and seafood in south Louisiana. We specialize in competition style barbeque from the Carolinas, Missouri, Texas and Tennessee regions. Located in Baton Rouge, we are committed to being a part of the community and having personal relationships with our farmers and purveyors. We strive to provide a warm and relaxing atmosphere.

places.title: Gus's Barbecue - South Pasadena
places.description: Since 1946, Gus’s has been serving the good folks of South Pasadena (and beyond!) true Southern hospitality and some of the best real pit BBQ around. Housed on historic Route 66, Gus’s is a tribute to Southern life, where family, tradition and celebration are of the utmost importance. A menu filled with traditional Southern cooking is complemented by an impressive range of whiskies, wines, cocktails and local craft beers. Today, Gus’s is a space for a warm welcome, a cold mint julep, and a big plate of the best flavors from the American South and Midwest.

places.title: Iron Pig American BBQ
places.description: We are back to our normal business hours. We are the first original American BBQ in Chengdu, Sichuan, China. All our meats are cooked in our smoker (The only smoker in Sichuan)

places.title: Real Q
places.description: Real Q is Winston Salem's best spot for Pit-Cooked Lexington Style BBQ. "If it ain't over wood, it ain't as good."

places.title: McKenzie's Barbeque & Burgers  Montgomery
places.description: For a taste of traditional, Texas-style barbecue, join McKenzie's Barbecue & Burgers for lunch, dinner or both! Try our sandwiches with your choice of filling: sliced beef, chopped beef, turkey, ham, chicken, hot link, sausage, sloppy jo, pork loin or pulled pork. Can't decide? Try our plates with your choice of 1, 2, 3 or 4 meats with two sides. For the real carnivore, you can have the plate with meat only, no sides. Hosting an event? You can order our meats by the pound.

places.title: Gonzales Food Market
places.description: One of top BBQ in all of Texas

places.title: Clyde Iron Works
places.description: Premier restaurant, bar, and event venue located in Duluth, MN. Established in 1889, the original Clyde Iron Works was a steel foundry and manufacturer of heavy machinery, once instrumental in completing well-known projects such as the Panama Canal, Empire State Building and Golden Gate Bridge. Today, it serves as one of the top restaurant, bar and event venues in northern Minnesota — still honoring the American worker and Duluth's golden industrial age.

places.title: City Barbeque
places.description: Fast-casual barbeque restaurant serving authentic comfort food. Serves award-winning BBQ, huge sandwiches, homemade sides, fresh salads, and incredible desserts. All meats—beef brisket, pulled pork, St. Louis–cut ribs, Amish chickens, turkey breast, and special-recipe sausage—are smoked on site, and all sides and desserts are made fresh daily in the restaurant. Caters thousands of events every year, of all sizes and styles: everything from formal weddings and backyard graduation parties to company picnics and family reunions. Great for lunch, dinner, dine-in, or carryout. Supports teammates and communities alike; prioritizes giving back to local charities and non-profits.
